verdict.rationale: The GitHub README describes a terminal agent and says the `zcode` command passes any arguments other than `--web` to an existing Agent CLI. That implies the agent can be invoked from scripts, but nothing documents a non-interactive, headless or print mode. One community comment claims ZCode is GUI-only with no CLI, which conflicts with the README and further weakens confidence. Missing for 10: a documented non-interactive/headless run mode, scripting flags or output formats for automation, examples of use in scripts or CI, and independent hands-on confirmation.
